card.name: Start of citations and section labels
card.fires_on: Words that open a reference or label, such as Citation, Title or Journal, and the break after a heading or author list. Also fires partway through some long science words like apoptotic.

modes.label: Citation and field labels
modes.description: Marks the word that starts a reference entry or a labelled field, or the dash or period right after a title or author list.
modes.example: Publication Date: January 4, 2010 C<<itation>>: Little, N., Morse, S

modes.label: Inside apoptosis words
modes.description: Fires on the middle of the word apoptosis or apoptotic in discussions of brain development.
modes.example: has been reported to result in widespread<< apopt>>otic neurodegeneration in the developing brain
